name: autocache
description: Session continuity for Claude Desktop: explicit breadcrumbs, checkpoints, handoffs and reminders, kept as local JSON on this computer.
long_description:
Autocache keeps the state of a work arc on your own disk so the next chat can pick up where this one stopped. Claude Desktop chats have no lifecycle hooks, so nothing is captured automatically: Claude calls these tools explicitly (the Autocache skills tell it when).

**Privacy.** State lives under `~/.autocache/stores/claude-desktop` as plain JSON files. No account, no telemetry, no network access: the server only reads and writes that local folder. Uninstalling the extension does not delete that folder; delete it yourself if you want the history gone.

Runs on the Node.js runtime that Claude Desktop includes.

tools.name: autocache_status
tools.description: Read bounded health and continuity counts from the local Autocache store.

tools.name: autocache_resume
tools.description: Read a resume packet: last session summary, active breadcrumb, latest checkpoint and due reminders.

tools.name: autocache_breadcrumb_start
tools.description: Start one explicit breadcrumb; refuses when another is already active in this store scope.

tools.name: autocache_breadcrumb_step
tools.description: Append one milestone to the active breadcrumb.

tools.name: autocache_breadcrumb_complete
tools.description: Mark the active breadcrumb complete with an explicit outcome.

tools.name: autocache_breadcrumb_abort
tools.description: Mark the active breadcrumb aborted with a reason, keeping its record.

tools.name: autocache_checkpoint
tools.description: Save an explicit bounded checkpoint of the current work arc.

tools.name: autocache_handoff
tools.description: Save a local continuation packet; sends nothing and transfers no ownership.

tools.name: autocache_reminders_list
tools.description: List reminders from the local store.

tools.name: autocache_reminders_add
tools.description: Add one reminder, optionally with an ISO-8601 due time or a recurrence.
